items.raw_excerpt: This word serves as solid evidence that it's not only international foreigners that can be made to feel less than welcome when they move to a new German community.
items.summary_en: The Local Germany shares its German word of the day: Zugezogene. The word describes people who move into a new German community. It shows that not only foreign arrivals can feel less than welcome there.
items.summary_ko: 더 로컬 독일이 오늘의 독일 단어 'Zugezogene'를 소개했습니다. 이 단어는 새로 이사 온 사람들을 뜻하며, 새로 온 사람을 환영받지 못한다고 느끼게 할 수 있습니다. 해외에서 온 사람이 아니어도 그런 느낌을 받을 수 있다는 것을 보여 줍니다.
items.title_en: German word of the day: Zugezogene
items.title_original: German word of the day: Zugezogene

items.raw_excerpt: Increasing préfecture delays mean that many foreigners in France now face the prospect of either being forced to cancel travel plans, or trying to travel with the temporary 'récépissé', here's what you need to know about travelling with this document.
items.summary_en: Long delays at French prefectures mean many foreigners must cancel travel plans or travel with a temporary recepisse. Here is what you need to know about using this document while waiting for a new residence permit.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스 관청 처리가 늘어나 많은 외국인이 여행 계획을 취소하거나 임시 접수증을 들고 출국하는 상황에 놓였다. 새 체류허가증을 기다리는 동안 이 서류로 여행할 때 알아두어야 할 내용을 정리했다.
items.title_en: Travelling with a recepisse after French carte de sejour expires

items.raw_excerpt: For when you're a bit winded.
items.summary_en: The word 'puha' is used in Danish when someone is a bit winded or relieved. It's a small phrase that captures a feeling many people share.

items.title_en: Danish word of the day: puha

items.raw_excerpt: More than 30 million people visited a museum in the Netherlands in 2025, a 2.5% increase over the year prior, according to trade association Museumvereniging. Dutch museums welcomed 31.6 million visitors in 2025, almost back to pre-pandemic levels. In 2019, museums saw 32.6 million guests. Nearly 90% of Dutch people go to a museum at least once a year, the Museumcijfers 2025 report found. In 2025 the Netherlands had 492 registered museums. Most institutions are history museums, making up 62%,...
items.summary_en: Dutch museums welcomed more than 30 million visitors in 2025. That is almost back to the level seen in 2019. Nearly 9 out of 10 Dutch people visit a museum at least once a year.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 박물관의 2025년 방문객이 3천만 명을 넘어섰다. 이는 팬데믹 이전 수준인 2019년과 거의 비슷한 규모다. 네덜란드인의 약 90퍼센트는 1년에 한 번 이상 박물관을 찾는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title_en: Dutch museum visits rose to over 30 million last year

items.raw_excerpt: São sete estados com Lei Seca em todo o território e cinco com a restrição em zonas específicas.
items.summary_en: Seven states in Brazil have a full dry law, and five more limit drinks in certain areas. The rules apply during the 2026 election period. People should check the rules in their own state before they vote.
items.summary_ko: 브라질에서 일곱 개 주가 전체 음주를 금지하고, 다섯 개 주는 특정 지역에만 제한을 둡니다. 이번 제한은 2026년 선거 기간에 적용됩니다. 투표 전에 자신이 사는 주의 규정을 확인하는 것이 좋습니다.
items.title_en: Dry Law: Where Drinks Are Limited in the 2026 Elections

items.title_original: Lei Seca: confira onde haverá restrição a bebidas nas eleições 2026

items.raw_excerpt: Minimum wage hikes from 25 to 40 cents take effect Thursday in five provinces.
items.region: Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia
items.summary_en: Minimum wage goes up on Thursday in five Canadian provinces. The hourly increase ranges from 25 to 40 cents. The provinces are Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, and Nova Scotia.
items.summary_ko: 목요일부터 캐나다 5개 주에서 최저시간급이 오릅니다. 시간당 인상 폭은 25센트에서 40센트 사이입니다. 대상 주는 매니토바, 서스캐처원, 온타리오, 프린스에드워드아일랜드, 노바스코샤입니다.
items.title_en: Minimum wage increases in 5 Canadian provinces
items.title_original: Minimum wage increases in 5 provinces: Man., Sask., Ont., P.E.I. and N.S.

items.raw_excerpt: Norman Rodríguez disparó contra el árbitro luego de la derrota del cuadro lila y aseguró que al juez FIFA "le quedó grande el partido".
items.summary_en: Norman Rodríguez criticized referee Garay after his team lost to O'Higgins in the Copa Chile. He said the FIFA referee was not up to the level of the match.
